```{shinylive-r}
#| standalone: true
#| viewerHeight: 760
library(shiny)

### renderPlot replacement: Safari 27 (WebKit) cannot hold the call stack of
### shiny::renderPlot in webR ("Maximum call stack size exceeded"), so draw with
### renderImage instead, which nests about 45 fewer R calls
renderPlot <- function(expr, width = "auto", height = "auto", res = 72, ...,
                       env = parent.frame(), quoted = FALSE) {
    func <- shiny::exprToFunction(expr, env, quoted)
    shiny::renderImage({
        info <- shiny::getCurrentOutputInfo()
        w  <- if (is.numeric(width))  width  else info$width()
        h  <- if (is.numeric(height)) height else info$height()
        shiny::req(w > 0, h > 0)
        pr <- shiny::getDefaultReactiveDomain()$clientData$pixelratio
        if (is.null(pr)) pr <- 1
        f   <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
        dev <- shiny:::startPNG(f, w * pr, h * pr, res = res * pr)
        on.exit(grDevices::dev.off(dev), add = TRUE)
        grDevices::dev.control(displaylist = "enable")
        v <- withVisible(func())
        if (v$visible) print(v$value)
        list(src = f, contentType = "image/png", width = w, height = h,
             coordmap = shiny:::getCoordmap(v$value, w * pr, h * pr, res * pr))
    }, deleteFile = TRUE)
}

ui <- fluidPage(
    wellPanel(
        fluidRow(
            column(4,
                sliderInput("mu_hat", "mu (data location)", min = -5, max = 25, value = 8, step = 0.5),
                sliderInput("n_pts", "number of grid points in u (over 0 to 1)",
                            min = 2, max = 25, value = 9, step = 1)),
            column(8,
                helpText("The grid is a midpoint rule, uniform in u over (0, 1); ",
                         "each point's mu is recovered as logit(u). Try mu = 0 ",
                         "first (the grid sits right under the mass, and the two ",
                         "legend numbers agree closely), then move mu up to 8 or ",
                         "20: the quadrature estimate drifts far from the true ",
                         "value however many grid points you add. The right plot shows ",
                         "the function the midpoint rule actually integrates over u: ",
                         "the rectangles are the quadrature, and their total area is ",
                         "the estimate.")))
    ),
    fluidRow(
        column(6, plotOutput("squeeze", height = "440px")),
        column(6, plotOutput("integrand", height = "440px"))
    )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {

    output$squeeze <- renderPlot({
        n_eff <- 3                                  # likelihood as if 3 obs, sigma = 1
        L     <- function(mu) dnorm(input$mu_hat, mu, 1 / sqrt(n_eff))
        prior <- function(mu) dnorm(mu, 0, 5)
        z     <- function(mu) L(mu) * prior(mu)

        log_sum_exp <- function(lx) { m <- max(lx); m + log(sum(exp(lx - m))) }

        ### this z(mu) is a normal-normal conjugate kernel, so the true log
        ### marginal likelihood is available directly by numerical integration
        log_marlik <- log(integrate(z, -Inf, Inf)$value)

        lo <- -20; hi <- 20                  # fixed x-axis
        mu_grid <- seq(lo, hi, length.out = 500)

        u_pts  <- (seq_len(input$n_pts) - 0.5) / input$n_pts   # midpoint rule, uniform on (0, 1)
        mu_pts <- log(u_pts / (1 - u_pts))          # mu = logit(u)

        ### the midpoint-rule quadrature estimate actually built from this grid:
        ### integral of z(mu) dmu = integral of z(logit(u)) / (u(1-u)) du
        log_z    <- function(mu) dnorm(input$mu_hat, mu, 1 / sqrt(n_eff), log = TRUE) +
            dnorm(mu, 0, 5, log = TRUE)
        h        <- 1 / input$n_pts
        log_marlik_quad <- log_sum_exp(log_z(mu_pts) - log(u_pts * (1 - u_pts))) + log(h)

        par(mar = c(4, 4, 2, 4))
        plot(mu_grid, z(mu_grid), type = "l", lwd = 3, col = "firebrick",
             xlab = expression(mu), ylab = expression(z(mu) == pi(mu) * L(mu)))
        polygon(c(mu_grid, rev(mu_grid)), c(z(mu_grid), rep(0, length(mu_grid))),
                col = adjustcolor("firebrick", 0.15), border = NA)
        segments(mu_pts, 0, mu_pts, z(mu_pts), col = "gray30", lwd = 1.5)
        points(mu_pts, z(mu_pts), pch = 19, col = "gray30")

        par(new = TRUE)
        plot(mu_grid, plogis(mu_grid), type = "l", lwd = 3, col = "steelblue",
             axes = FALSE, xlab = "", ylab = "", ylim = c(0, 1))
        axis(4, col.axis = "steelblue", col.ticks = "steelblue")
        mtext(expression(u == 1 / (1 + e^-mu)), side = 4, line = 2.5, col = "steelblue")

        guide_col <- adjustcolor("gray50", 0.6)
        segments(mu_pts, 0, mu_pts, u_pts, col = guide_col, lty = 3)
        segments(mu_pts, u_pts, max(mu_grid), u_pts, col = guide_col, lty = 3)
        points(mu_pts, u_pts, pch = 19, col = "gray30")

        legend("topleft", bty = "n", lwd = c(3, 3, NA, NA), col = c("firebrick", "steelblue", NA, NA),
               legend = c(expression(z(mu) == pi(mu) * L(mu)),
                          expression(u == 1 / (1 + e^-mu)),
                          as.expression(bquote("true"~log~P(y) == .(round(log_marlik, 3)))),
                          as.expression(bquote("quadrature, this grid"~log~P(y) == .(round(log_marlik_quad, 3))))))
    })

    output$integrand <- renderPlot({
        n_eff <- 3
        g <- function(u) {                            # z(logit(u)) / (u(1-u)), the integrand in u
            mu <- qlogis(u)
            exp(dnorm(input$mu_hat, mu, 1 / sqrt(n_eff), log = TRUE) +
                dnorm(mu, 0, 5, log = TRUE) - log(u * (1 - u)))
        }
        n      <- input$n_pts
        h      <- 1 / n
        u_pts  <- (seq_len(n) - 0.5) / n
        g_pts  <- g(u_pts)
        u_fine <- seq(0.0005, 0.9995, length.out = 2000)
        g_fine <- g(u_fine)

        true_val <- integrate(g, 0, 1, subdivisions = 1000L, stop.on.error = FALSE)$value
        quad_val <- sum(g_pts) * h

        par(mar = c(4, 4, 2, 1))
        plot(u_fine, g_fine, type = "l", lwd = 3, col = "firebrick",
             ylim = c(0, max(g_fine, g_pts) * 1.1), xlab = expression(u),
             ylab = expression(g(u) == z(logit(u)) / (u * (1 - u))))
        rect(u_pts - h / 2, 0, u_pts + h / 2, g_pts,
             col = adjustcolor("gray50", 0.3), border = "gray30")
        points(u_pts, g_pts, pch = 19, col = "gray30")
        legend("topright", bty = "n", lwd = c(3, NA, NA), col = c("firebrick", NA, NA),
               legend = c(expression(g(u)),
                          as.expression(bquote("true area" == .(signif(true_val, 4)))),
                          as.expression(bquote("midpoint rule" == .(signif(quad_val, 4))))))
    })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```

## About the app

Shows how a fixed quadrature grid can miss the posterior mode entirely, so that the computed marginal likelihood is badly wrong. The app models a single unknown mean $\mu$.

````r
        L     <- function(mu) dnorm(input$mu_hat, mu, 1 / sqrt(n_eff))
        prior <- function(mu) dnorm(mu, 0, 5)

        mu_grid <- seq(lo, hi, length.out = 500)

        u_pts  <- (seq_len(input$n_pts) - 0.5) / input$n_pts   # midpoint rule, uniform on (0, 1)
        mu_pts <- log(u_pts / (1 - u_pts))          # mu = logit(u)

        ### the midpoint-rule quadrature estimate actually built from this grid:
        ### integral of z(mu) dmu = integral of z(logit(u)) / (u(1-u)) du
        log_z    <- function(mu) dnorm(input$mu_hat, mu, 1 / sqrt(n_eff), log = TRUE) +
            dnorm(mu, 0, 5, log = TRUE)
        h        <- 1 / input$n_pts
        log_marlik_quad <- log_sum_exp(log_z(mu_pts) - log(u_pts * (1 - u_pts))) + log(h)

        par(mar = c(4, 4, 2, 4))
        plot(mu_grid, z(mu_grid), type = "l", lwd = 3, col = "firebrick",
             xlab = expression(mu), ylab = expression(z(mu) == pi(mu) * L(mu)))
        polygon(c(mu_grid, rev(mu_grid)), c(z(mu_grid), rep(0, length(mu_grid))),
                col = adjustcolor("firebrick", 0.15), border = NA)
        segments(mu_pts, 0, mu_pts, z(mu_pts), col = "gray30", lwd = 1.5)
        points(mu_pts, z(mu_pts), pch = 19, col = "gray30")

        par(new = TRUE)
        plot(mu_grid, plogis(mu_grid), type = "l", lwd = 3, col = "steelblue",
             axes = FALSE, xlab = "", ylab = "", ylim = c(0, 1))
        axis(4, col.axis = "steelblue", col.ticks = "steelblue")
        mtext(expression(u == 1 / (1 + e^-mu)), side = 4, line = 2.5, col = "steelblue")

        guide_col <- adjustcolor("gray50", 0.6)
        segments(mu_pts, 0, mu_pts, u_pts, col = guide_col, lty = 3)
        segments(mu_pts, u_pts, max(mu_grid), u_pts, col = guide_col, lty = 3)
        points(mu_pts, u_pts, pch = 19, col = "gray30")

        legend("topleft", bty = "n", lwd = c(3, 3, NA, NA), col = c("firebrick", "steelblue", NA, NA),
               legend = c(expression(z(mu) == pi(mu) * L(mu)),
                          expression(u == 1 / (1 + e^-mu)),
                          as.expression(bquote("true"~log~P(y) == .(round(log_marlik, 3)))),
                          as.expression(bquote("quadrature, this grid"~log~P(y) == .(round(log_marlik_quad, 3))))))
    })

    output$integrand <- renderPlot({
        n_eff <- 3
        g <- function(u) {                            # z(logit(u)) / (u(1-u)), the integrand in u
            mu <- qlogis(u)
            exp(dnorm(input$mu_hat, mu, 1 / sqrt(n_eff), log = TRUE) +
                dnorm(mu, 0, 5, log = TRUE) - log(u * (1 - u)))
````
